longStrings.long.faq.a1: Wo din a wode bɛhyɛn yɛ «کد ملی», na system no na ɛbɔ password no te sɛnea ɛba no, na ɛde fa Shad so kɔma wo nɔma a wokyerɛw no. Sɛnea wɔhyɛn no yɛ pɛ ma users nyinaa — fi sukuu panyin kosi sukuuni. Bere a woahyɛn nea ɛdi kan no, sesa wo password fi profile no mu; eyi yɛ dwoodwoo ma wo account no.
longStrings.long.faq.a10: Wɔ final report card no nkyɛn no, Bahar yɛ adwuma ho nkwaaso ma sukuuni biara bosome biara: bosome no nyinaa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn, da a wɔbaa ne da a wɔannaa, ne assignments a ɛwɔ bosome no mu. Wɔda eyi adi ma sukuuni ne ɔwofo wɔ grades beae no so, sɛnea wɔbɛhunu nkɔso a ɛba bosome biara.
longStrings.long.faq.a1NoShad: Wo din a wode bɛhyɛn yɛ «کد ملی», na system no na ɛbɔ password no te sɛnea ɛba no, na sukuu panyin no de ma wo. Sɛnea wɔhyɛn no yɛ pɛ ma users nyinaa — fi sukuu panyin kosi sukuuni. Bere a woahyɛn nea ɛdi kan no, sesa wo password fi profile no mu; eyi yɛ dwoodwoo ma wo account no.
longStrings.long.faq.a2: Frɛ wo sukuu panyin. Ɔpanyin no fi users panel no mu bɛtumi abɔ password foforo a ɛba te sɛnea ɛba no ama wo, na ɔde fa Shad so akɔma wo. Wɔkora passwords so wɔ encrypted form mu; obiara — mpo ɔpanyin no — nhunu wo password a ɛwɔ hɔ nnɛ; nea wobetumi ayɛ nko ara ne sɛ wɔbɔ password foforo.
longStrings.long.faq.a2NoShad: Frɛ wo sukuu panyin. Ɔpanyin no fi users panel no mu bɛtumi abɔ password foforo a ɛba te sɛnea ɛba no ama wo, na ɔde bɛma wo. Wɔkora passwords so wɔ encrypted form mu; obiara — mpo ɔpanyin no — nhunu wo password a ɛwɔ hɔ nnɛ; nea wobetumi ayɛ nko ara ne sɛ wɔbɔ password foforo.
longStrings.long.faq.a3: Wɔyɛɛ internal messenger no ma nsɛm tiawa ne akɛseɛ a ɛnyɛ duru nko ara, sɛnea server no bɛkɔ so ayɛ ntɛm bere nyinaa. De fael, mfoni ne nsɛm akɛseɛ mena no, fa Shad di dwuma; Bahar bɛka eyi kyerɛ wo wɔ internal messenger no mu.
longStrings.long.faq.a3NoShad: Wɔyɛɛ internal messenger no ma nsɛm tiawa ne akɛseɛ a ɛnyɛ duru nko ara, sɛnea server no bɛkɔ so ayɛ ntɛm bere nyinaa. De fael, mfoni ne nsɛm akɛseɛ mena no, fa nkitahodi akwan a wɔtaa de di dwuma no; Bahar bɛka eyi kyerɛ wo wɔ internal messenger no mu.
longStrings.long.faq.a4: Web version no yɛ adwuma wɔ browsers nyinaa mu, na saa version no ara na wɔde si app te sɛ deɛ ɛwɔ Android ne Windows so; kyerɛ sɛ account baako, platform mmiɛnsa. Wɔsan de Android version no sɛ APK fael a ɛdɔɔso ma sukuu no.
longStrings.long.faq.a5: Wɔde cryptographic password generator na ɛbɔ passwords, na wɔkora so sɛ hash. Sɛ wɔbɔ mmɔden bɛyɛ a ɛnyɛ yie mpɛn pii a, wɔtoto account no bere tiaa mu, na ɛsɛ sɛ wobɛsesa password no bere a woahyɛn nea ɛdi kan no. Bahar nkora password biara so sɛ text a ɛda hɔ.
longStrings.long.faq.a6: Sukuuni no fael no bi ne ne ho nsɛm nyinaa, ne ɔhwɛfo no ho nsɛm nyinaa (din, «کد ملی», telefon nɔma ne Shad nɔma). Akyerɛkyerɛfo, mmɛyɛfo ne akwankyerɛfo no fael nso bi ne wɔn ankasa ho nsɛm nyinaa. Wɔma kwan kɔ fael biara so ma roles a wɔagye atom nko ara.
longStrings.long.faq.a6NoShad: Sukuuni no fael no bi ne ne ho nsɛm nyinaa, ne ɔhwɛfo no ho nsɛm nyinaa (din, «کد ملی» ne telefon nɔma). Akyerɛkyerɛfo, mmɛyɛfo ne akwankyerɛfo no fael nso bi ne wɔn ankasa ho nsɛm nyinaa. Wɔma kwan kɔ fael biara so ma roles a wɔagye atom nko ara.
longStrings.long.faq.a7: Bere a sukuu panyin no bɛyɛ anaasɛ bɛsesa ɔboafo anaa ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo biara no, ɔkyerɛkyerɛ pefee beae ahorow a ɔbɛtumi akɔ so: sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛw nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn, attendance, sukuuni management anaa events. Nsesae biara a wɔbɛyɛ no bɛyɛ adwuma ntɛm ara, na wɔbɛkyerɛw no wɔ activity report no mu.
longStrings.long.faq.a8: Sukuu panyin no bɛtumi abɔ ne Shad account no mu mpɛn baako pɛ; fi saa bere no, Bahar bɛsoma user foforo biara din ne password kɔ Shad nɔma a wɔakyerɛw no so. Eyi yɛ ɔkwan a ɛboa nko ara; sɛ wɔannɔɔ so a, ɔpanyin no de password no bɛkɔma user no ɔkwan foforo so.
longStrings.long.faq.a9: Aane. Wɔ browser so install nko ara nkyɛn no, wɔde Bahar Android project fael no ma sukuu no, na wotumi de Android Studio dan no APK ntɛm ara; ɛnhia Google Play.

Bɔ country pack no mu dwuma ansa na sukuu afe no afi ase, sɛnea keys no bɛyɛ pɛ fi mfiase. Wɔnyɛ calendar data a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no automatic conversion (wɔakyerɛw saa limitation yi pefee).

Default ɔman no ne Iran; sɛ wode country pack no gu so a, system no nyinaa bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ wo ɔman no nsɛm mu.
longStrings.long.kit.countries.mapIntro: Wɔyɛɛ Bahar Iran map no fi GADM 4.1 mu, de Douglas-Peucker simplification dii dwuma — fa saa pipeline no ara di dwuma ma wo ɔman.

longStrings.long.kit.countries.mapStep3: Ma province biara: { name, d, cx, cy } — d yɛ SVG path (ɛfi M), cx/cy yɛ center ma hover label.
longStrings.long.kit.countries.mapStep4: Set viewBox no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ ne bounds nyinaa (te sɛ Iran: ۷۶۰×۶۸۸).
longStrings.long.kit.countries.mapStep5: Fa map section no ka JSON no ho — sɛ province biara name ne regions names yɛ pɛ a, map button no bɛpaw saa province no.
longStrings.long.kit.countries.step1: template.json fael no yɛ Iran profile pɛpɛɛpɛ — provinces ۳۱ ne counties ۴۲۹, Shamsi calendar, national code mod-11, mobile ۰۹…, toman, grade ۷ kosi ۱۲, ne week Sat kosi Wed. Fa wo ɔman no values si field biara anan mu.
longStrings.long.kit.countries.step2: Ɛwɔ section biara ase wɔ saa page yi so no, wɔakyerɛw fields no ne type, range ne Iran example. Field a ɛho hia a ɛnnihɔ = wɔbɛgyina package no wɔ validation mu (wobɛnya Persian error pɛpɛɛpɛ).
longStrings.long.kit.countries.step3: Fa provinces/states ne counties gu regions mu. Sɛ wopɛ SVG map nso a, yɛ paths fi wo ɔman official GeoJSON mu de Douglas-Peucker simplification (command pɛpɛɛpɛ no wɔ page no ase). Map no yɛ optional — sɛ ɛnni hɔ a dropdown nko ara na ɛbɛda adi.
longStrings.long.kit.countries.step4: Super admin no bɛupload fael no wɔ settings → «Country» tab no so. Dry validation (؟validate=1) no bɛsɔ structure, calendar, regexes, regions ne map hwɛ, na ɛbɛma stats — errors no yɛ Persian na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
longStrings.long.kit.countries.step5: Sɛ wɔde «activation» no di dwuma a, system no nyinaa calendar (date display + attendance keys), national code/mobile validation wɔ login ne register, province ne grade dropdowns, currency ne workweek nyinaa bɛkɔ ɔman foforo no so. Sɛ wobɛsan akɔ Iran no, click baako nko ara.
longStrings.long.kit.languages.cta: Download template no, translate no, na fa system admin no so activate no — wo users nyinaa bɛpaw kasa foforo no ntɛm ara.
longStrings.long.kit.languages.hero: Bahar UI no default yɛ Persian — nanso language pack ma wotumi translate panel no nyinaa kɔ kasa biara mu: English, Arabic, Turkish, Kurdish, Gilaki, Balochi anaa wo sukuu local kasa. JSON structure no yɛ mmerɛw, translation a ɛnnwie mpo yɛ permissible, na keys a wɔanntranslate no bɛsan akɔ Persian. Ma wo mfiase nyɛ ntɛm no, download English pack a ɛwɔ hɔ (app keys ۲۰۰; site sentences ne long texts no wɔ completion so) na fa di dwuma sɛ template.
longStrings.long.kit.languages.step1: Download Bahar official template fael no — ɛwɔ translatable keys nyinaa wɔ standard JSON structure mu, ne guide a ɛwɔ fael no mu.
longStrings.long.kit.languages.step2: Translate Persian text a ɛwɔ key biara mu kɔ target kasa no mu. Key a wɔanntranslate no, yi no fi mu — saa nsɛm no bɛsan akɔ Persian automatic, na biribiara bɛsɛe.
longStrings.long.kit.languages.step3: Kyerɛw kasa code a ɛdɔɔso (te sɛ en anaa kurdish-sorani), Persian din, native din ne text direction (rtl/ltr) wɔ fields a ɛwɔ fael no soro no mu.
longStrings.long.kit.languages.step4: Super admin no bɛupload fael no wɔ settings → «Languages and translation» no mu; system no bɛsɔ hwɛ, asusuw coverage percentage, na activate pack no.
longStrings.long.kit.languages.step5: Bere a wɔde no adi dwuma no, kasa foforo no bɛda adi wɔ users nyinaa language selector mu (web, Android, Windows), na wɔbɛset UI direction no automatic.
longStrings.long.kit.languages.structureNote: Wɔsɔ packs no hwɛ ansa na wɔakora so (field types, text lengths, executable code a ɛnni hɔ), na super admin nko ara na ɔbɛtumi aupload na wɔade adi dwuma. Text display no nyinaa yɛ ne safe HTML escaping.
